samples.summary: The new notifyStyleApplied() calls in toggleList/indent/outdent fan out to every onCursorMove subscriber, not just the toolbar — including the presence broadcaster in docs-view.tsx, which now republishes an unchanged caret to Yorkie presence for these three commands (they previously did not notify at all). Each synthetic fire resets `lastCursorUpdate` / re-arms the trailing timer, so a real caret move immediately after a bullet/indent click can be delayed by up to CURSOR_UPDATE_THROTTLE (100ms, docs-view.tsx:93), and the trailing write lands asynchronously (`store.updateCursorPos`, yorkie-doc-store.ts:2828) with no addToHistory guard — the exact race the updateCursorPos doc comment warns about (yorkie-doc-store.ts:2832-2842) if it interleaves with a later setCursorForHistory/mutation pair. Same fan-out also drives scheduleSpellRecheck (editor.ts:1163), so list toggles now schedule a spell recheck. Impact is small, but the fix (if wanted) belongs on the new call sites: notify only the style/toolbar consumers, or skip presence when the caret did not move.
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-view.tsx:394-411 registers a presence publisher on editor.onCursorMove; packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1130 fireCursorMoveCallbacks invokes ALL subscribers (Set at editor.ts:1154), so the new notifyStyleApplied() at editor.ts:2888/2912/2934 reaches it. Throttle bookkeeping at docs-view.tsx:396-410.

finding.summary: `EditorAPI.toggleList` still does not fire the cursor-move callbacks, so the exact staleness this diff fixes remains reachable when a bullet is toggled on a heading block
finding.evidence: `toggleList` (packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2871-2885) ends at `render()` with no `notifyStyleApplied()`, unlike the `setBlockType` this diff patched (and unlike the text-box editor's `toggleList`, packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:1135, which does notify). It is reachable from the docs toolbar list buttons: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:779/783 and packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-paragraph-group.tsx:176/194. When the caret sits in a `heading` block, `toggleList` calls `doc.setBlockType(block.id, 'list-item', …)`, so `getBlockType().type` becomes `list-item` → `getBlockLabel` returns "Normal text" (packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-style-options.ts:106-114) and `blockTypeToStyleId` returns "normal" (ibid:121-129). With no callback fire, the toolbar's `refresh` (docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:317-324) never runs, so the Text style button keeps showing "Heading 1" and the menu keeps the Heading 1 checkmark — the same #792 symptom on a sibling entry point. The task note (docs/tasks/active/20260817-block-type-toolbar-refresh-todo.md:21-27) declares this unobservable because "TextStyleGroup never offers list-item", but the label is derived from the block's *actual* type, not from the offered options, so the heading→list-item transition is observable. Fix belongs in the new code's neighbour: add `notifyStyleApplied()` to `toggleList` (and, for consistency, `indent`/`outdent` at editor.ts:2904 and :2925).

verdict.reason: The finding claims `EditorAPI.toggleList` ends at `render()` with no `notifyStyleApplied()`. Reading the cited range shows the opposite: `toggleList` calls `notifyStyleApplied()` at packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:2888, immediately after `invalidateLayout(); render();`, with a comment naming the heading→list-item staleness and issue #792 as the reason. The two consistency sub-asks are also already satisfied: `indent()` notifies at editor.ts:2912 and `outdent()` at editor.ts:2934. A regression test exists at packages/docs/test/view/editor-on-cursor-move.test.ts:193 ('toggleList fires the callbacks with the new type readable'), and the task note the finding quotes as denying observability now records the work as done at docs/tasks/active/20260817-block-type-toolbar-refresh-todo.md:41. The reviewer's reported empty repo-wide grep for `notifyStyleApplied` is contradicted by the repository, which returns 17 call sites in editor.ts alone. Since the notify is on the path reached from docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:779/783 and text-paragraph-group.tsx:176/194, there is no unguarded/bypassing entry point for the list-toggle case.
